search.website_text:
FF14 Dalamud plugin for replacing the loading screens with custom art. # Custom Loading Screens
A quick and dirty re-implementation of VanillaPlus's FancyLoadingScreens with custom image paths.

## How to use
* Open up the config UI with `/customloadingscreens`
* Press the `Add Image` button
* Find your image in the file browser
* Add it
* Go teleport!

## How to install
This plugin is undergoing the submission process for the main repository. Until then- you may use the custom repository listed here

* Open up `/xlsettings`
* Go to the `Experimental` tab
* Scroll down to `Custom Plugin Repositories` (Read the warning! Then ignore it because you trust me /s)
* Add `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Abyeon/CustomLoadingScreens/refs/heads/master/repo.json`

## Credits
* [KamiToolKit](https://github.com/MidoriKami/KamiToolKit)
* [VanillaPlus](https://github.com/MidoriKami/VanillaPlus)
* [FancyLoadingScreens](https://github.com/MapleHinata/Dalamud.LoadingImage)
* [Dalamud](https://github.com/goatcorp/Dalamud)
* [FFXIVClientStructs](https://github.com/aers/FFXIVClientStructs)
